outcome.technical: tools/lints/_output_lints.py: new section 'one parse per file per process' - _PARSE_MEMO (one entry per path: (sha256 digest, src, tree)), parsed_source(path, filename=None, memo=None) reading the bytes on every call and hitting only when path AND sha256(bytes) match (never mtime/size), raising OSError/UnicodeDecodeError/SyntaxError as the replaced open+ast.parse did so each site keeps its own except and wording, failures never memoised, text-mode newline translation reproduced; parsed_sources(dirs=None, memo=None) -> [(rel, path, src, tree)] over lint_py_files, an unparseable file kept as a row (src None, exception in place of the tree); poisoned_parses(memo=None) compares each memoised tree with an independent fresh parse (ast.dump) and flags attributes hung on nodes; PARSE_ROOTS. All fifteen lint parse sites now read parsed_source (12 open+parse pairs mechanically, path_preamble_violations, text_encoding_violations via a new optional tree= argument on unencoded_text_io, and depth_sensitive_paths, which now reads the memoised tree of the unaltered source and drops the preamble's lines via new _preamble_lines(src) instead of parsing a blanked copy). tools/prove-gates.py: imports _output_lints; _gate_sources keeps its own walk (file set unchanged) and parses each file through _output_lints.parsed_source; 'parsed_sources' added to _TREE_WALKS (a lint written over the memo walk is still derived); NOT_A_GATE row for parsed_sources; ds5 ALLOW row re-pointed to '        inside = _preamble_lines(src)' -> '        inside = set()' (the only anchor quoting an ast.parse line); new selftest case ng4 (derivation reads through the memo and poisons none of it). tests/test__output_lints.py: _parse_memo_cases pm1-pm9; the doubled label+condition lint calls in f2, te11, bc4, nw4, sd3, rj5, rw5, pp1, ds1 bound to one local each. PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md: one paragraph in the _output_lints section. CONTRIBUTING.md unchanged: grep -n -i parse finds no sentence on how a lint reads the tree. Copy decision: shared tree, no copy (deepcopy of _output_lints.py's tree 41 ms vs parse 13 ms, measured once) - proven by pm8 (all 15 derived no-arg readers run over the real tree, 326 trees fresh-compared, none poisoned) and ng4 (186 trees after the prover's derivations). Optional _tree_answer memo NOT taken: the suite patches L.LINTS_DIR around real-tree calls (lines near 1076-1082), so a cross-case answer memo would serve a stale answer; the label+condition doubles were bound to locals instead. Red-first probe (git archive HEAD + git diff applied in mkdtemp, anchor asserted once and landed, __pycache__ purged each cycle): baseline 9/9 green; key on path only -> pm3,pm4 red; key on mtime+size -> pm3,pm4; drop memo -> pm2,pm5; poisoned_parses dump half dropped -> pm5; attribute half dropped -> pm6; a lint hangs an attribute -> pm8; prover derivation hangs an attribute -> ng4; prover parses around the memo -> ng4; _preamble_lines mid-line whole=True -> pm9; preamble lines not left out -> ds1,ds4,ds5. prove-gates --list: every row anchored (191 anchored, 2 reason-recorded). Whole table: python3 tools/prove-gates.py exit 0, 100 of 100 gates proven red, 91 of 91 guards quiet, wall 1473 s under load 21-59. Times (single runs, load-before in brackets): test__output_lints HEAD 65.4 s [29.1] and 64.4 s [5.0], task 51.2 s [7.8] and 51.0 s [4.5]; prove-gates --selftest HEAD 50.3 s [13.3] -> task 16.8 s [5.6] (once each); gate_names() x10 in-process HEAD 12.72 s -> task 0.28 s (once each). Dependants run green: test__output_lints 182/182, test__deps 266, test__refs 292, test__output 91, test__doctor_hygiene 42, test__panel_settings 78, test__report_page 29, test_drive_phase 745, test_stamp_verification 356, tools/affected.py 57, tools/sweep-selftests.py 160, tools/gate-parity.py 119 (plain run exit 0), prove-gates --selftest 66; ruff and vermin -t=3.8- clean on the three .py files.
outcome.descriptive: Each file is parsed once per distinct content per process for the tree lints and the gate prover's derivation, keyed on sha256 of the bytes; test__output_lints 64-65 s -> 51 s, prove-gates selftest 50 s -> 17 s.
